title: DarkUpgrades
description: A clean dark-mode Minecraft GUI with classic hotbar styling.
body:
DarkVanilla+ is a clean and polished dark-mode resource pack designed for players who prefer a modern, darker Minecraft interface while keeping the original vanilla style intact.

Instead of completely redesigning Minecraft's menus, DarkVanilla+ focuses on preserving the familiar look and feel of the game while replacing bright GUI elements with darker, more comfortable alternatives. The result is a sleek interface that feels native to Minecraft and remains easy to use during long play sessions.

Features
Dark User Interface
Dark inventory screen
Dark crafting table interface
Dark chests and storage containers
Dark furnace, smoker, and blast furnace GUIs
Dark enchanting, anvil, loom, smithing, stonecutter, and more
Dark pause menu and various menu screens
Classic Hotbar

DarkVanilla+ includes a classic-style hotbar design inspired by older Minecraft UI aesthetics, providing a clean and familiar experience while maintaining compatibility with modern versions.

Vanilla-Friendly Design
Original slot positions preserved
Original layouts preserved
No GUI scaling changes
No offset issues
Fully compatible with vanilla gameplay
Comfortable for Long Sessions

The darker color palette reduces the amount of bright UI elements on screen, creating a more comfortable experience when playing at night or for extended periods.

Compatibility
Minecraft 1.20-1.21.11
Works with Vanilla Minecraft
Works with Fabric
Works with most shader packs
Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
Included Extras
Custom DarkVanilla+ branding
Customized menu text
Modified advancement notifications
Modified recipe notifications
Classic hotbar selection style
